metric_groups.description: OCR: character/word error where labels permit, field extraction precision/recall/F1, latency, RAM/VRAM. A metric a given dataset's labels cannot support (e.g. no field-level ground truth) is still a required key, valued None, never omitted.
CDR/finance: normalization accuracy, schema/validation error rate, event coverage, latency.
Detection: precision, recall, mAP where labels permit, latency, VRAM/RAM.
Tracking: IDF1/HOTA/MOTA where labels permit, ID switches, latency, VRAM/RAM.
Visual text (OCR applied to video/image regions): mirrors the OCR metric group, since it is the same underlying task applied to a different upstream detector's crops.
VAD: not in the task's own metrics table -- Nipun's own minimal, reasonable extension for completeness (voice-activity accuracy where labels permit, plus latency/RAM).
ASR: WER/CER, real-time factor, latency, RAM/VRAM.
Diarization: DER, speaker-turn quality where labels permit, latency, RAM/VRAM.
Language identification: not in the task's own metrics table -- Nipun's own minimal, reasonable extension for completeness (accuracy where labels permit, plus latency).

Social/text: extraction precision/recall/F1, language handling, latency. Forward-compatible only -- no Part 1 candidate exists for this task yet; the existing deterministic social/chat parsers are today's baseline.

Cross-linking: Precision@K, Recall@K, false-positive rate, calibration/Brier score when applicable, explanation completeness, deterministic reproducibility, latency. Never a guilt score -- see ADR-016.
